snippet:
**Gladly MCP by usefulapi** is an MCP server, a connector that lets an AI assistant use it as a tool. It is hosted: an assistant connects to it over the internet, nothing to install.

As declared in the Official MCP Registry · hosted endpoint tested by Electra Index 3m ago (live check)
Hosted endpoint
- `https://gladly.usefulapi.io/mcp` streamable-http
In Claude Code: `claude mcp add --transport http gladly-mcp-by-usefulapi https://gladly.usefulapi.io/mcp`
MCP settings (Claude Desktop, Cursor and other MCP clients)
```
{
"mcpServers": {
"gladly-mcp-by-usefulapi": {
"url": "https://gladly.usefulapi.io/mcp"
}
}
}
```

title: Gladly MCP Server for AI Agents (65 Actions)
snippet:
# Gladly MCP Server
for AI Agents
Connect your AI agent to StackOne's Gladly MCP server and give it 65 MCP tools out of the box. Auth, tool execution, and security all managed.

### 65 Agent Actions
Create, read, update, and delete across Gladly — and extend your agent's capabilities with custom actions.
![](/_astro/light-orange-fingerprint.R770-NAv.svg)
Authentication
### Agent Tool Authentication
Per-user OAuth in one call. Your Gladly MCP server gets session-scoped tokens with zero credentials stored on your infra.

A Gladly MCP server lets AI agents read and write Gladly data through the [Model Context Protocol](/platform/mcp/) — Anthropic's open standard for connecting LLMs to external tools. StackOne's Gladly MCP server ships with 65 pre-built actions, fully extensible via the [Connector Builder](/platform/ai-integration-builder/) — plus managed authentication, prompt injection defense, observability, and agent execution runtime. Connect it from MCP clients like [Claude Desktop](/platform/mcp/ai-agent/claude-desktop/), [Claude Code](/platform/mcp/ai-agent/claude-code/), [Cursor](/platform/mcp/ai-agent/cursor/), [Goose](/platform/mcp/ai-agent/goose/), and VS Code, or from agent frameworks like OpenAI Agents SDK, LangChain, and Vercel AI SDK.

Does StackOne have a Gladly MCP server?
Yes. StackOne offers a hosted Gladly MCP server with 65 pre-built actions, and every action is tested and QA'd by StackOne. Connect it to [Claude](/platform/mcp/ai-agent/claude-desktop/), [Cursor](/platform/mcp/ai-agent/cursor/), and any other [MCP client](/platform/mcp/), or to any agent framework through the [AI Action SDK](https://docs.stackone.com/agents/typescript/introduction). It ships with managed [agent authentication](/platform/agent-auth/), [prompt injection defense](/platform/prompt-injection-guard/), and [tool discovery](/platform/tools-discovery/) with [server-side execution](/platform/agent-execution-engine/) that preserve your agent's context window and keep reasoning performance.
Gladly MCP server vs direct API integration — what's the difference?
A Gladly MCP server and [direct API integration](/connectors/gladly/) serve different use cases. Direct API integration is for software-to-software — backend code calling Gladly. A Gladly MCP server is for AI agents — [MCP clients](/platform/mcp/) like Claude and Cursor, plus framework agents built with OpenAI, LangChain, or Vercel AI — discovering and calling Gladly at runtime. StackOne provides both.

title: Gladly MCP server for Claude & ChatGPT | usefulapi
snippet:
# Gladly MCP server
Find customers, read conversations, items and tasks; add internal notes in Gladly. Hosted by **usefulapi**: connect it to Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor or any MCP client.

### Pull up a customer and review their conversations
Find a customer by email, phone number or external id. Then list their conversations with topics, status and assignee, oldest first, so an agent sees the history.
### Read the timeline of one conversation
Open a conversation and list its messages, emails, calls and notes in order. Ask the assistant for a short summary before you take over the case.
### Check which tasks are still open for a customer
List the open tasks of a customer with assignee and due date. Use it to see which follow-ups are late before you answer the customer.

### Add an internal note after a customer contact
Write an internal note on a conversation, for example a call back request. Only agents see the note. Each call adds a new note.
Changes data
## How do I connect Gladly?
### Before you connect
The login page asks for your **Gladly organization**, **Agent email** and **Gladly API token**.
Create the token in Gladly → **Settings → API → Create API token**. The agent needs the API User permission. The token is used only to call the Gladly API on your behalf and to derive a private account id; it is never shown to anyone.
### Claude claude.ai · Desktop
1. Open **Customize → Connectors**, then click **+ Add → Add custom connector**.
2. Enter the name **Gladly** and this URL, then click **Add**:
https://gladly.usefulapi.io/mcp
3. Claude opens the login page: enter your **Gladly organization**, **Agent email** and **Gladly API token**.
4. In a chat, click **+ → Connectors** and turn on **Gladly**.
Team and Enterprise: an Owner adds the connector for the organization first.
### ChatGPT chatgpt.com
1. Open [Plugins](https://chatgpt.com/plugins), click **+**, then **Add custom MCP server**.
2. Enter the name **Gladly** and this URL, choose **OAuth** as the authentication, confirm the warning and create it:
https://gladly.usefulapi.io/mcp
3. ChatGPT opens the login page: enter your **Gladly organization**, **Agent email** and **Gladly API token**.
4. In Plugins, install **Gladly**, then choose it in a chat.

Any client that supports remote MCP servers (Streamable HTTP) with OAuth login: Claude (web and desktop), Claude Code, ChatGPT, Codex, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf and others.
